name: Custom Classes
description: Adds custom character class names AND custom subclasses (scoped per class) to the host's class lists. New classes/subclasses appear in every class dropdown the host renders — Spell Library filters, Allowed-classes checkboxes on individual spells, the Spell Library picker on character sheets, the export modal, and the player character sheet's Class + Subclass dropdowns. Lists sync live across DM and players in the same session.
author: TableTop Forge
